metadata.description: GreenLight Motion by WPSoul: an agentic motion engine and workflow. Scene pages and a library of ready-made scenes, the storyboard and the editable preview, the render engine and the exports, as one plugin.

plugins.name: greenlight-motion
plugins.description: GreenLight Motion (GL Motion), an agentic motion engine and workflow: turns a brief into a finished film. Every scene is a web page the agent writes (HTML, CSS, SVG, canvas, three.js), frame-exact on a page clock, or one of 275 ready-made library scenes. Story and art direction, a storyboard of stills, a player preview where you click any element to change it, voice-over, sound effects, a frame-exact HTML render engine (MP4, WebM alpha, ProRes 4444), and exports to the GreenLight Dash Video Editor or an After Effects package an agent builds natively.
